svg.title: Verdict
svg.desc: The TradingAgents graph runs on a local model: four analysts, a bull and bear debate, research manager, trader, three risk debaters and a portfolio manager produce a rating that is translated into an ATR-sized paper trade.
svg.text: A research companion for NSE stocks: runs the
TradingAgents graph on a local model and turns
its rating into a risk-sized paper trade.
Nifty 500 screener feeding the agent graph
Translator: rating → side, ATR stop, 2R target
Ollama tool-calling chat over the portfolio
author of the app layer, 7 test files
